description: Produces phase-shifted copies of a phasor, as ramps and as sine waves, each output a quarter cycle further on

inputs.text: The phasor being copied and shifted, 0-10V; voltages outside that range wrap back into it

outputs.text: The input phasor passed through as a 0-10V ramp, with no shift
A 0-10V ramp a quarter of a cycle ahead of the input
A 0-10V ramp half a cycle ahead of the input
A 0-10V ramp three quarters of a cycle ahead of the input
The input subtracted from 10V, a 0-10V ramp descending where the input ascends
A 0-10V sine wave at the phase of the input
A 0-10V sine wave a quarter of a cycle ahead of the input
A 0-10V sine wave half a cycle ahead of the input
A 0-10V sine wave three quarters of a cycle ahead of the input
The unshifted sine wave subtracted from 10V, so it falls where that one rises

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
